archived.why: Captain direction 'ALL OUT of LimeZu' — every world pixel becomes owned generated art, so a corpus of LimeZu scenes measures frames against the look we are deliberately leaving. Preserved verbatim and still runnable: `calibrate.py all --corpus corpus-limezu-2026-07-08 --out-dir <tmp>` reproduces the exact pre-refit calibration, and the calibration it produced is also kept at calibration/archive/limezu-2026-07-08/.
archived.relabelled: Only the per-image `file` prefix was rewritten when the directory moved (corpus/ -> archive-limezu-2026-07-08/, paths are corpus-relative). Every sha256 below is the ORIGINAL byte hash and is unchanged — `build_corpus.py verify --corpus corpus/archive-limezu-2026-07-08` proves it.
archived.nesting: Nested INSIDE corpus/ deliberately. A sibling corpus-*/ directory needs its own .gitignore rule, and cognitive-architecture-census.py derives `durable_store_units` from .gitignore's wildcard-free prefixes — so a sibling reads as a NEW organ of memory and trips a zero-headroom budget (97 -> 98). It is not a new organ; it is this organ's own history. Nesting says so structurally and needs no new ignore rule at all.
archived.tracked_copy: The tracked record is calibration/archive/limezu-2026-07-08/corpus-manifest.json — identical bytes. This copy is the working one the gitignored pixels sit beside.
